name: SHOWNOTES
source: Drowned in Sound and SHOWNOTES brand kit, 2 November 2026

pink.use: Print pink. Page fills, headlines, labels, emphasis text. Second most common fill in the magazine.

pink-logo.use: Pink inside the digital logo files. Use for anything sitting next to the logo on screen.

ink.use: Body text on light pages, text on pink.

black.use: Large black shapes, circles and black page fills. Most common fill by area.

paper.use: Body text on black or pink pages (a very slightly lilac off-white).

white.use: Wedges, tags, cut-out shapes, photo credits on dark.

logo-white.use: Off-white inside the digital logo file.

yellow.use: Appears once, tiny. Not part of the system. Do not use.

body.colour: ink on white, paper on black/pink

run-in.use: intro paragraph at the top of a feature, on pink or black

label.use: section labels such as FEATURE, OPINION, COVER STORY, INTERVIEW. In print these sit on a tilted wedge; for social assets use the label as plain text only.

headline.face: A different display face per feature
known: BT Super Seventy (cover, Spread Like Wildfire)
Becker Gothics Concave (Flower Power With Punch)

stand-in-for-web.note: Temporary until the licensed font files are supplied.

vocabulary: right-angled wedge with one slanted cut
tilted tag on a white wedge
shape.fill: flat colour only: no gradients, no glow, no drop shadows
shape.note: Shapes may frame or sit behind a layout but must not contain text.

rules: Text never sits inside a shape. Shapes are decorative only and stay separate from type.
The magazine's tilted tags (FEATURE, OPINION) are text on a wedge. Do not recreate them in generated assets. Set labels as plain text on the black background.
Flat colour only: no gradients, no drop shadows. (Pin glow is allowed on the web map only.)
One typeface family per asset for text, pink for emphasis, paper (#F1E8F3) for body on black.

video.added: 1 Nov 2026, from the Rou Reynolds podcast episode

grade.base: Fujifilm Eterna-style film look, flat colour, richer than natural, skin warm but not red.

fuji_camera.use: Fuji interview camera, node 02 after a plain node 01

iphone_wide.use: iPhone wide shot, matched to the Fuji with skin slightly less red

grade.how: One still per camera from a graded timeline, applied to every clip of that camera. Then check the LUT tick on each camera, because a node appearing does not prove which LUT it is.
grade.other_variants: Alternatives tested (Natural, Pro Neg, Classic Chrome, Astia and iPhone variants) are in luts/ if the Fuji look needs revisiting.

type.headline: Alternate Gothic No2, capitals
type.subtitle: Cardo Bold
type.logo_only: Druk is for the logo only, never live text

colour.note: Flat colour only, no gradients or shadows. Black is the brand kit black, also used for the subtitle strip.

reels_safe_zone.button_rail: 100px wide at bottom right, from about 750px up, so text stops 135px from the right edge near the bottom

rules: Logo small, top right, about 256px tall
Open and close with matching logo bumpers
No end-card box and no LINK IN BIO line, the caption carries the link
Title overlays held for 5 seconds or more
Subtitles: continuous black strip, 72px at 1080 wide, no gaps between lines, none on 16:9
